title: platform-standup-2026-03-17
content:
Platform Engineering - Daily Standup (Tue 2026-03-17)
Time: 09:30-09:50 PT (20m) | Attendees: Avery C., Riley K., Samira O., Jordan L., Priya M., Theo R.

1) Quick updates (round-robin)
- Avery: control-plane rollout v1.12 is live to canary (10% traffic). Observing slightly higher 503s on route /v1/generate for short seqs (<32).
  - Yesterday: completed canary deploy, smoke tests, updated rollout policy to set conservative concurrency for canary nodes.
  - Today: watch metrics, validate rollback trigger thresholds, open PR to tighten healthcheck timeout.
  - Blockers: need metrics dashboard to show per-route 503 breakdown (ticket PLT-4281 assigned to Riley).

- Riley: routing policy experiment ongoing (latency-based routing). Small bug: requests with explicit model pin were getting routed to fallback tier incorrectly.
  - Yesterday: traced mismatch to policy evaluation order; created fix in routing engine.
  - Today: deploy fix to staging, run load test.
  - Blockers: need update to integration test harness to simulate multi-variant routing (PR linked).

- Samira: quotas/quotas-enforcement - started phased rollout of per-customer soft limits.
  - Yesterday: implemented soft-limit notifications via Usage service; pushed to staging.
  - Today: wire up alerting to customer-ops Slack channel and verify throttling behaviour for bursty clients.
  - Blockers: deciding on default soft->hard transition time (open question: 5m vs 15m), feedback from CS needed.

- Jordan: auth/token rotation & billing token expiry cleanup.
  - Yesterday: completed migration of long-lived tokens to new KMS scheme; rotated test tokens.
  - Today: plan for 2-hour maintenance window next week for prod rotation (tentative).
  - Blockers: need signoff from security; Pinged Anna in sec-compliance.

- Priya (SRE): Observability notes - traces for canary show 95th pctl increase ~30ms on canary nodes; need to determine whether kernel or scheduling.
  - Action: will run perf profiling with flame graphs tomorrow.

- Theo (Platform eng intern): working on automating quota backfill script; demo in next standup.

2) Deep-dive items
- Control plane canary 503 spike
  - Hypothesis: KV cache warmup slower on canary nodes due to slightly older snapshot format.
  - Mitigation: warming jobs queued to pre-populate cache on node startup; canary nodes will be cycled after warmup.
  - Action: Riley + Avery to coordinate warmup job (PLT-4302) and add metric for KV hit-rate by node id.

- Routing policy ordering fix
  - Root cause: policy engine evaluated fallback match before pin-match when both conditions present. This allowed fallback routing to override explicit model pins in edge-case requests.
  - Fix: change eval order and add test coverage for 'pin + fallback' combo. Deployed to staging; monitor for regressions.

- Quotas design decision: soft to hard transition duration
  - Options: 5 minutes (stricter) vs 15 minutes (gives clients breathing room).
  - Pros/cons: 5m reduces abuse faster but increases false-positive throttles for legitimate spikes. 15m smoother but larger potential spend.
  - Next step: CS to provide 10 example customer profiles for review. Action: Samira to schedule sync with CS (due EOD Thu).

3) Incidents / Recent retros
- Incident last Friday: short outage for dedicated region us-west-2 due to quota service memory leak (root cause merged). Post-mortem doc in progress: link in artifacts.
- Follow-ups: add memory limit and leak detector to quota service container; Jordan handling PR for resource limits.

4) Action items / owners
- Riley: PLT-4281 - per-route 503 dashboard (due 2026-03-19).
- Avery + Riley: PLT-4302 - KV cache warmup job and metric (due 2026-03-20).
- Samira: schedule CS sync re: soft->hard transition + collect 10 customer profiles (due 2026-03-19).
- Jordan: open maintenance window request and get security signoff for token rotation (due 2026-03-18).
- Priya: perf profiling for canary nodes and flame graphs (due 2026-03-18).
- Theo: demo quota backfill automation in Wed demo (2026-03-18).

5) Notes / open questions
- Should we temporarily increase canary traffic to 20% to get faster signal? Pro: faster validation. Con: larger blast radius. Suggestion: hold at 10% until warmup job in place.
- Need consensus on default soft->hard transition time. If no decision by Thu, default to 10m and revisit after CS feedback.
- Decide whether to include per-route KV metrics in public dashboard or internal only (privacy/cost).

6) Links / refs
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/512 (routing policy fix)
- Tickets: PLT-4281 (dashboard), PLT-4302 (kv warmup), PLT-4277 (quota memory leak postmortem)
- Runbook: confluence:platform-control-plane-runbook

Meeting adjourned 09:50 PT. Next standup Wed 2026-03-18 09:30 PT.

Notes: informal; capture of main points and action items. Contains TODOs and unresolved questions for product/CS/security.
